item.title: Financial Aid and FAFSA Information Session
item.description:
The Oxford Lane Library is hosting a Financial Aid and FAFSA Information Session on Monday, March 2 from 6:00-7:30 p.m. at 441 S. Locust St. Students and family members are invited to attend a presentation by a University of Cincinnati enrollment services representative who will explain types of financial aid available and discuss new FAFSA guidelines. TSD approved for Talawanda High School students to attend, but not affiliated with TSD.

item.title: Weekly Athletics Update and Cheerleading Tryouts
item.description:
The Weekly Athletic Updates are available to view by clicking the provided link. Cheerleading tryout prep clinics are scheduled for Monday, March 9th and 16th from 2:30-4pm at TMS, open to Talawanda students in grades 6-11. A parent and athlete meeting will be held Monday, March 16th at 5:30pm at TMS. Tryout clinics run March 23-25 from 3-5pm at TMS, with actual tryouts on Thursday, March 26th starting at 3:15pm. Contact Janna Eason at 513.273.3305 or easonj@talawanda.org for questions.

item.title: Senior Cap and Gown Orders Due
item.description:
Seniors must order cap and gown from Jostens.com as soon as possible. Delivery will occur during the first week of May at THS lunches (Butler Tech students receive theirs at their campus). Gowns are rentals and must be returned to Jostens after the graduation ceremony.

Senior yearbook portraits are due March 27th. Photos must be portrait format, larger than 1MB, and follow student code of conduct. Submit via QR code with access code talawanda2026 or email to yearbook@talawanda.org. School ID photos will be used if no portrait is submitted. Senior ads are also available for $25-$100.

item.title: Class of 2026 Latin Honors Recognition
item.description:
The Class of 2026 Latin Honors recipients have been announced across three distinction levels:

  • Summa Cum Laude (4.2+ GPA): 35 students including Sadie Abbitt, John Larson, Katelyn Bulanda, and others
  • Magna Cum Laude (4.0-4.199 GPA): 27 students including Jake Barkhuizen, Mila Misco, Kiera Breen, and others
  • Cum Laude (3.8-3.99 GPA): 22 students including Channing Adkins, Chase Anderson, Lucy Berberich, and others

Students who believe they qualify but are not listed should contact their school counselor immediately.

item.description:
Senior portrait deadline is March 27th. Submit portraits by scanning the QR code with access code talawanda2026 or email photos larger than 1MB to yearbook@talawanda.org. item.description:

item.title: Kiwanis Chili Supper Fundraiser at THS
item.description:
The Kiwanis Club of Oxford is hosting an all-you-can-eat Chili Supper on Thursday, February 26, 2026 from 5:00-7:00 PM at the Talawanda High School Cafeteria. The meal includes a variety of chili soups with crackers and cheese, cornbread, coleslaw, dessert, and drinks. Attendees can vote for their favorite chili. Suggested donations: Adults $10, Children (6-11) $7, 5-and-under free. Tickets are available from Kiwanis members or at the door. Proceeds support children in the Oxford community.

item.title: Flu and Seasonal Illness Health Reminder
item.description:
The school is experiencing an increase in flu and seasonal illnesses. Keep your child home if they have: fever (100°F or higher), vomiting or diarrhea, significant cough, sore throat with fever, body aches, extreme fatigue, or flu-like symptoms. Students must be fever-free for 24 hours without medication and symptom-free for 24 hours after vomiting or diarrhea before returning to school.
